scripts.infra:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.legacy:seed: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && dotnet run --project legacy/src/Budgets.Legacy.Seed -c Release --
scripts.legacy:api: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && dotnet run --project legacy/src/Budgets.Legacy.Api --urls http://127.0.0.1:5080
scripts.v2:migrate: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && pnpm --filter @budgets/api exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.v2:seed: pnpm v2:migrate && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && pnpm --filter @budgets/api seed --
